title: Kubernetes Payment API Root Cause Analysis (WASM-verified grading)
summary: Same task surface as computing_math/k8s_payment_api_root_cause_analysis: diagnose a production payment API outage from Kubernetes incident artifacts and write root_cause_report.json. Sole difference: the evaluator's decision core runs in a deterministic WASM engine, emitting an ale-wasm-receipt/1 (BLAKE3-chained audit facts) that anyone can recompute in a browser.
taskPrompt:
You are working on a Linux VM.

## Task Directory
`base`

## Visible Inputs
- Task prompt: `base/input/TASK_PROMPT.md`
- Kubernetes incident artifacts: `base/input/` (cluster state, deployment manifest, failing pod log)
- Python entry point: `base/software/python`

## Your Task
Diagnose the root cause of the payment API outage from the incident artifacts. Identify the primary, secondary, and tertiary root causes with evidence, list affected resources, and propose a remediation plan. Write the required report to:

`base/output/root_cause_report.json`

The report must contain: incident_metadata (with safe_to_rollback), root_causes (type/severity/description/evidence), affected_resources, remediation_plan, and summary.
agentMustDo: Ground every root cause in evidence quoted from the provided artifacts.
Use canonical resource identifiers (kind/name@namespace) matching the incident artifacts.
Write a valid root_cause_report.json with all five required top-level keys.

inputFiles.name: TASK_PROMPT.md
inputFiles.description: Normalized solve-time instructions staged for the agent.

inputFiles.name: cluster_state.txt
inputFiles.description: Kubernetes cluster state dump at incident time.

evaluation: The bridge layer validates the report schema (three hard gates: parseable JSON, required top-level keys, non-empty causes) and scores seven components (primary/secondary/tertiary cause identification, affected-resource set F1, remediation-plan pattern coverage, evidence grounding, summary/rollback), pre-normalized to integer basis points (official scorer semantics, emitting auditable component values); the WASM ruleset sums the seven components behind the hard gates as the scoring SSOT. Emits ale-wasm-receipt/1, independently recomputable via the bundled verify.html.
